_comment: One unit of competency. It exists as a file because the catalogue lists a unit — and Moodle gets a grade item for it — only once this file ships. The lessons below were READ OFF the built pages' data-criteria, not asserted here, so this cannot drift from what is actually taught.
title: Identify joint families and select a joint

criteria.text: Group wood joints into the five families: corner, frame, widening, lengthening and crossing joints.
Name common joints within each family and say what each is used for.
Select a joint for a job, giving a reason from strength, appearance and the direction of load.
Explain why a widening joint is used for a table top and a lengthening joint for a truss member.
